summary: fix(settings): bold email address on code verification screens
description:
## Because

- `ConfirmResetPassword` and `SigninPasswordlessCode` already show the destination email in bold.
- The sign-up and sign-in code screens showed that email in normal weight, so the two screens looked different from the rest.

## This pull request

- Adds `font-bold` to the email span in `ConfirmSignupCode`.
- Adds `font-bold` to the email span in `SigninTokenCode`.
- Changes both spans in each file: the one in `FtlMsg` `elems.email`, and the English fallback.
- Needs no Fluent string change. Both strings already wrap the email in an `<email>` elem, so the ids stay the same.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: FXA-13592
